title: Towards Data-Efficient, Real-Time World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22497v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: State-of-the-art world models have been used to produce sequences of gameplay that accord with provided user-input actions. However, high quality, consistent gameplay generation often comes at the cost of inference speed, making real-time interactive play and ideation challenging. The substantial quantities of data used to train state-of-the-art models have also made custom training of these models appear impractical, limiting many of their potential uses in creative fields. In this work we demonstrate a major step towards efficient world models: achieving both fast high-quality inference, and improved data efficiency. This is done by replacing the next-token prediction paradigm with a two-stage discrete diffusion-based approach, introducing a lightweight refinement transformer which carries out iterative masked predictions. translated_title: 迈向数据高效、实时运行的世界模型
translated_abstract: 最先进的世界模型已被用于生成符合用户输入动作的游戏过程序列。然而，高质量且一致性的游戏生成往往以牺牲推理速度为代价，这使得实时交互式游玩和创意构思变得困难。此外，训练最先进模型所需的海量数据也使得这些模型的定制化训练显得不切实际，限制了它们在创意领域的许多潜在应用。在这项工作中，我们朝着高效世界模型迈出了重要一步：同时实现了快速的高质量推理和更高的数据效率。这是通过用两阶段离散扩散方法取代下一词元预测范式来实现的，并引入了一个轻量级的细化transformer来执行迭代式的掩码预测。该方法构建于一个能够生成高度一致且复杂的分钟级长序列的自回归世界模型之上。
tldr: 该论文用两阶段离散扩散方法取代下一词元预测范式，并引入轻量级细化transformer进行迭代掩码预测，在实现快速高质量推理的同时显著提升了世界模型的数据效率，为实时交互式世界模型奠定了基础。
en_tdlr: The paper replaces the next-token prediction paradigm with a two-stage discrete diffusion approach featuring a lightweight refinement transformer for iterative masked predictions, achieving both fast high-quality inference and improved data efficiency for real-time world models.
